proposed_solution:
We propose a high-performance, Azure-native AI Contract Intelligence platform tailored for Apex Global Solutions. The core of the solution is built on Azure Document Intelligence and Azure OpenAI Service, deployed strictly within your private tenant to ensure 100% data residency. The system will ingest documents from SharePoint via a secure connector, process them using advanced OCR and LLM-based extraction, and store the resulting data in a RAG-enabled vector store for context-aware querying.

To ensure the required 92% accuracy, we include a robust Human-in-the-loop (HITL) portal. Any extraction falling below the 88% confidence threshold is automatically routed to this portal for manual verification by your SMEs. Once validated, the structured data is pushed via RESTful APIs to your SAP and Property Management databases. The solution also features an Automated Alerting Module that proactively monitors notice windows and renewal dates, directly addressing the goal of eliminating financial risk from missed deadlines.

The architecture is designed for high availability (99.5% uptime) and security, utilizing Azure Private Link and Managed Identities to keep all traffic within your private VNET. This setup prevents any data from leaving the designated US-East/East-US-2 regions, fully complying with your security mandates.
core_delivery_approach: We follow an Agile delivery methodology, organized into two-week sprints. This approach ensures transparency, allows for iterative feedback from Apex stakeholders, and enables us to adapt to evolving requirements while maintaining a steady path toward the final deployment.
domain_expertise: Our team possesses deep expertise in legal document automation and enterprise-grade AI implementations. We have a proven track record of delivering secure, high-accuracy extraction solutions for the real estate and financial sectors, specifically within the Microsoft Azure ecosystem.

summary: A comprehensive proposal for an Azure-native AI Contract Intelligence platform designed to automate document extraction, ensure 100% data residency, and eliminate financial risks for Apex Global Solutions.
our_understanding:
Apex Global Solutions is seeking a sophisticated AI-driven solution to modernize its contract intelligence capabilities. Currently, manual extraction processes for commercial leases and supplier contracts present a significant financial risk, particularly regarding missed notice windows and unintended auto-renewals. The primary objective is to automate these extractions with high accuracy while maintaining a 50% reduction in operational costs.

A critical component of this requirement is the strict adherence to data residency and security. The solution must reside entirely within Apex's private Microsoft Azure tenant, specifically in the US-East or East-US-2 regions, with a total prohibition on external AI API calls. This necessitates a partner who can architect a secure, high-performance platform that integrates seamlessly with existing SharePoint and SAP ecosystems while providing a robust Human-in-the-loop (HITL) interface for quality assurance.
rate_card_and_change_control: Any changes to the agreed scope will be managed through a formal Change Request (CR) process. Each CR will be assessed for its impact on timeline and budget, with work commencing only after written approval from the Steering Committee.
pricing_approach: We propose a fixed-fee implementation model for the initial deployment, followed by a recurring monthly fee for managed support and maintenance. This provides budget certainty for the capital expenditure while ensuring ongoing operational excellence.
